notes.title: Thoughts about launching a demo
notes.content:
First of all: Thank you to all of you out there who looked into the demo... I was really stunned. 
Thank you for the reactions, good or bad, for the advice, for the ideas, for the bug searching with me... For noticing... 

I asked myself if it was right to push the demo out there. 
The game is in an early stage, the demo is not perfect (and may never be), it all needs a ton of work to do before i will call it a real game. 
I'm not really sure, I wanted to have it out there and so there it is.

To tell you something about myself:
I'm a single, part-time game dev working in webdevelopment for my main job (and I need that for the money).
I always wanted to create a game myself with creatures and monster collecting and some other stuff and this is it. 

My game. 

And so I'm doing this monstly for myself, following a dream I've had about giving life to a combination of game mechanics I was never able to find in other games, but always wanted to play and enjoy.
I want to share that game I dreamed of making with anyone who might have had that same experience, searching for that one game that had everything they wanted in it.
I will work on it constantly and would love your input and ideas and will try to integrate them into the game.

And what is to come?
As I said, I'm working constantly at it... But part-time. I cannot afford to do it full-time for the time being, that is a fact.
This will extend the timeline for getting all the stuff done that I want to be in the game. 

- TimeFlow -> As some players remarked, it is not good that there is no stopping the timeflow when you look into the inventory or talk to an NPC. 
So Timeflow will stop when you interact with an NPC or open the bigger UI stuff like the inventory, incubation stone or storage.
- WorldMap -> there will be a worldmap with an indicator for where the player is for better orientation.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43433865/76f4c357265d1b2fca39887f28543633548fcaee.png[/img]
- Storage -> some of the chests and other storage areas will be linked to the player, you will be able to place your own chests later. 
When opening a chest that is part of your private storage you will be able to go through all your storage parts and not only the one you have currently opened (I hate it myself when I have to search for this one chest I put a resource into that I suddenly need)
- Friendship-System -> you will be able to increase your friendship with the inhabitants of the island through tasks/quests you can do for them, getting shop product expansions and other forms from help from them in return.
- Monster Helper -> The monsters will be able to help you with your daily work like watering plants, gathering resources and maybe even more.
- Combat -> Yes, there will be combat later on, with your companion monster helping you out.
- Adventures -> One part of the game will be exploring some parts of the island that may be similar to a magic dungeon, rearranging itself every now and then.
- Coop -> I want to have a coop option for the adventures, but that is one of the things that will be taken care off after most of the other stuff
- Storyline -> There will be a storyline for you to explore when the game is getting out. A real one!

notes.title: State of the Game
notes.content:
Yeah, Sehoni Island is still in development. 
One of my big goals to get into the game before launching my demo was:
Controler Use for the game and being able to play with a controller.

This really sounds not SO hard... but there is SO MUCH stuff you need to consider when you started the UI with just a Keyboard and Mouse mindset so it took me quite some time to get the controller stuff done... but right now, today, i finished my last task for controller control.

Yeah still no demo out there, but a big step toward it.
I sill need to fix some bugs and finish the storyline for the demo, so you can get a small gameplay experience from it. 

What i did in all the time:
- Creating a vituall Keyboard for controller use
- Adding Silhouettes when you cross behind somethin like a building or trees
- Move Princess toward the counter, so you can talk with her without intruding her private space
- Fix the benches and stuff to not sometimes warp you into the void (yeah again, i somehow overlooked some warping abiliities the last time)
- Getting collissions back in the game... they where somehow lost so you could walk straight through trees, and walls and... 
- fixing some entrances so you really land what building you entered (weird experience to enter the inn and end up on the other side of the island)
- fixing the sound of the chopping, wich was awefully off
- adding a Typing sound for dialogues and adding a player setting option to deactivate it 
- adding user settings to set sound volumes
- adding some background music
- changed to 4.3 and so i needed to change some inner programming stuff for the use of TileMapLayers (year thats a godot thing)
- corrected some z-index so you won't walk over trees
- you can now interact with your tamed monsters again... wich somehow was lost somehow
- Working on steam integration and adding some Demo-Achievements
and finally:
- finishing controller support for now, i think you can now play all parts of the game with a controller and without using mouse or keyboard... yeah still a ton of bugs in there probably...

Right now i'm working on some more bugfixing and a rework of the steam-capsule design. I want a good one when launching the demo and finally adding more stuff to the game for the main storyline

notes.title: What happened in the last month? or: March Update
notes.content:
Here it is the march update ... 

I thought i was ready to finally get to content creation to finish the Demo-Storyline but some stuff got in my way (as it always does)...

I was really unhappy with my NPC just running straight across the map when using the Navigation Agent Godot provides (and to make stuff worse: sometimes they went a really weird ziggzagging way seemingly not knowing what they were doing) .. so i wanted to have not only Navigation but Pathfinding... like: Emma walks to the Farm and not across any fields or stuff but: she actually uses the paths... because... thats what paths are for, right?
Unfortunately the Navigation Godot provides is simply that: a navigation... wich works great in most ways but doesn't include weighting of areas and so... no pathfinding as in: prefer using some regions over others... 
There is a AStarGrid2D component in Godot, wich is great in pathfinding on one map ... but i have navigation across maps... so i worked on combining both systems... i got it working, but it took time and navigation/pathfinding still needs work so... but the big stuff is done, took some time, but it's done.

That took the most of my time ... other stuff  i worked on:
- switched the icons for clothes, so that they have the same color as the stuff you wear, you can unequip them now and they keep their color...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43433865/b70009552e75e78c423fb47267e57dbcdd6862bc.png[/img]

- i fixed a bug that when you tried to select seeds without having them you just got stuck and frozen
- Emma now moves to the Cave again so continuing the Questline will be able soon (and yes that one resulted in my reworking of the navigation for npc)
- Some minor stuff in visuals and sounds were done too

- NPCs now turn towards you when you talk to them
- Bugfix for build: Spritesheets for clothes and dialogue files are now loaded correctly in build. So you wont be naked and you can talk to the npcs in build now (yay)
- Changed the Layout of the start screen and the character generation
- Added all color options and hair options to the character gen
- Several Visual Bugs were fixed
- Several collision Bugs were fixed
- Points of Interest now correctly show a hint when you can explore them
- Added some deco for the village, like signs in front of the houses like inn or merchant

notes.title: October Status
notes.content:
October came and i reworked some more stuff. 
The village overhaul is done for the main tilemaps and the houses. 
Things i worked on in the last month:
- Tilemap reworks for the village and the houses
- Day-Night-Cycle: twinked the values and reworked it so it can be Season dependant, to have a different cycle each season
- Inn - Indoors: Every village needs a cozy inn
- Doors: You need to be able to travel through doors, right? 
- Windows in the indoors lighten and darken: working with the day night cycle windows will light up in the inside maps according to the daytime
- Stairs: Somehow stairs won't working anymore. Now they do and you can travel between different floors again
- Preselection of items: To be able to plant seeds you need to preselect/prepare it in the inventory. The old workflow was: go to the inventory, preselect up to 4 items and then you had a quick select. I changed that to be more controller friendly (or so i think): you can select one of the items in your inventory with a quickselect scrollwindow that only shows you the items in your inventory that you are allowed to select
- There was a funny bug where your clothes were unaffected by the day night cycle... was pretty weird when everything was dark except your clothes. I repaired the shader for the cloth coloring, now it is affected by the cycle too
- The Log was added, it may be for development purpose only or stay, not sure yet. It can be triggered in code to log stuff that happenes to the player or in the world in general
- Due to the UI/UX refactoring i removed the mainhand/offhand that survived some refactoring in the past but is not really fitting to the game
- Repaired the feedback for the player so there is some writing on the screen when something happend to the player
- Reworked some more ui/ux stuff
- Repaired and reworked the Message Board that will be somewhere in the Village

With all this done i really started working on the stuff that is needed so you will be able to play the mini storyline of the demo.
So, there is hope... 
There will be a Demo ;)

notes.title: There will be a Demo
notes.content:
We are currently working on a Demo for Sehoni Island. 
Demo-Release Date is scheduled for the second half of the year. 

The Demo will contain:
- Basic Mechanics like:
-- NPC Dialogues and basic Shops
-- Farming with Planting and Harvesting
-- Skill-System and Leveling
-- Basic Crafting
-- Basic Combat
- Monster Mechanics
-- Breed the fist monsters to get a glimpse in the mutations and genetics
-- Fight with your monster or let it help you on your farm

There will be NO Storyline in the Demo, we will save that for the Game itself.
